label: iPhone 17 Pro Max silicone MagSafe blank (6.9")

notes.measured: height_mm, width_mm, depth_mm are the supplier listing envelope (165 × 81 × 13 mm), confirmed 2026-09-08. depth_mm is the outer envelope of the case side wall, NOT wall thickness.
placeholder: wall_mm: guessed 1.8 mm silicone wall; measure with calipers.
camera_island: broad 72 x 43 mm surround, recessed deck and rolled lip interpreted from the supplied listing photos, not supplier CAD.

holes: one per lens/flash/mic/sensor, centres in mm from the island's top-left as seen from outside, diameters in mm. Laid out like the reference silicone blank (three lenses in a triangle, flash / mic / depth sensor in a column on the right). Every model gets its own list — this is what makes the case model-specific.
lens_rim: raised lip around each `lens` hole (width outward from the hole edge, height above the island top). Cosmetic until measured.
magsafe_ring: moulded ring + alignment line on the back, as a shallow groove. Centre is cy_from_top_mm below the top edge on the centreline. Placeholder until measured.
back_roll_mm, buttons and bottom openings are visual estimates; no model-fit claim.
notes.template: Print template pixel size = template_px_per_mm × ((width_mm + 2·depth_mm) × (height_mm + 2·depth_mm)) = 1070 × 1910. See pipeline/README.md.
